name: Sanka
description: Sanka Plugin for Claude helps you to run your entire sales in one place: CRM, CPQ, Pipelines, Billing and more.
longDescription:
Ships **153 skills** and **1 MCP server**.

- **Skills** (153): `apply-company-price-table-items` (Apply a company-wide price-table percentage across all items in live Sanka), `archive-private-message-thread` (Archive a private inbox thread in live Sanka), `cancel-calendar-attendance` (Cancel calendar attendance in live Sanka), `cancel-export-job` (Cancel export job in live Sanka), `cancel-import-job` (Cancel import job in live Sanka), `check-calendar-availability` (Check calendar availability in live Sanka), `connect` (Connect or re-authenticate the installed Sanka plugin in this thread), `create-bill` (Create bill in live Sanka), and 145 more
- **MCP servers** (1): `sakura`

Installs with `claude plugin install sanka@claude-community` from `sankaHQ/sanka-plugin`.
